metadata.description: Thinking-partner and multi-session workflow skills for Claude Code.

plugins.name: agent-coordination
plugins.description: Coordinate a deliberation across multiple AI agents (Claude, Gemini, Codex, Cursor, Antigravity, …) using a shared markdown log. Enforces preface format, phase model, convergence ledger, approval gate, and handoff protocol.

plugins.name: grill-me
plugins.description: Interview-style stress-test of a plan or decision. Walks every branch of the design tree, one question at a time, until shared understanding is reached.

plugins.name: handoff
plugins.description: Generates a copy-pasteable handoff block so a fresh Claude Code session can resume work with zero context loss.

plugins.name: parallel-dispatch
plugins.description: Turns a pre-built parallel work plan into copy-paste agent prompts plus a coordinator playbook. Validates file-scope conflicts.

plugins.name: quiz-me
plugins.description: Active-recall quiz on a topic, document, codebase area, or interview prep. One question at a time, adaptive difficulty.

plugins.name: pagecraft
plugins.description: Portable HTML formatting and visual-safety bundle (multi-skill plugin). Contains verify-text-wrap (caterpillar/right-edge probe + the wrap-safe runtime library), table-system-migration, number-formats (Macabacus financial format standard), reskin (detect a repo's design system and apply its brand frame across the site), and a pagecraft overview/installer — robust tables, financial number formats, headers/section dividers, design-system reskinning, and text-wrap prevention as patterns plus installable deterministic checks.

plugins.name: skill-drift-scanner
plugins.description: Audits Codex and Claude skill deployment drift, autosync health, scheduler status, and reload requirements across machine-level skill installs.

plugins.name: bogdan-baciu-design
plugins.description: Applies Bogdan Baciu's personal editorial design system to websites, static HTML, prototypes, documents, slide decks, and scoped financial-model artifacts. Bundles the Puddles sky-blue on warm-cream palette, Instrument Serif + Geist + JetBrains Mono typography, flat editorial layout rules, fonts, imagery, previews, and the .db-scope artifact styling.
